'''Gadux''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]].<ref name="TOR" /> Sometime in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|2}} Gadux is present on the Republic version of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. As the events on Balmorra for all Republic classes occur in Act II, it can be inferred they take place in 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. From this, it can be assumed Gadux was present on Balmorra in that year.</ref> he was in [[Farnel Outpost]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] base in [[Bugtown]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he sold various items.<ref name="TOR" />
